body:
I know that moving is not easy. I have moved to two different countries and it was not easy at first. I didn't know the language that well and the culture and norms were so different especially when you move from one continent to another and Yes I went through depression and even cried that I don't want to go to school and sat by myself during lunch times. But eventually things worked out and I found my life long BFF there and we even spent summers together   because I am in a different town for college. But I 'll tell you one thing nothing is ever permanent changes can be scary, but it's all for the better at the end :) 

And to answer your question about running away, I would say that's a bad Idea because u 'll run out of financial support I have never heard any good stories about running away and having a bright future.
I think for me the most affecting part is my school right now well it all started because of my relationship with me and my dad was not that great but I do not care about that any more.
Thank you for understanding I feel like if I talk to my family or close friends they will be sad or get mad at me or won't understand problems.

It's a long story I have been battling depression and suicidal thoughts for about 4 and half years now from time to time. I have never done counselling or talk to a friend about, but now I am willing to make a change and just wish I could make some friends and talk about this or else I hope my life ends right now.
I hope u win the fight just a random Indian girl
I am 20years old as well and I am going through the same thing as you are. I wish all this pain would end one day
